translations.en.sahih: About what are they asking one another?
translations.en.pickthall: Whereof do they question one another?
translations.en.yusufali: Concerning what are they disputing?
translations.id.indonesian: Tentang apakah mereka saling bertanya-tanya?

translations.en.sahih: About the great news -
translations.en.pickthall: (It is) of the awful tidings,
translations.en.yusufali: Concerning the Great News,
translations.id.indonesian: Tentang berita yang besar,

translations.en.sahih: That over which they are in disagreement.
translations.en.pickthall: Concerning which they are in disagreement.
translations.en.yusufali: About which they cannot agree.
translations.id.indonesian: yang mereka perselisihkan tentang ini.

translations.en.sahih: No! They are going to know.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but they will come to know!
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, they shall soon (come to) know!
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak; kelak mereka akan mengetahui,

translations.en.sahih: Then, no! They are going to know.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, again, but they will come to know!
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, verily they shall soon (come to) know!
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian sekali-kali tidak; kelak mereka mengetahui.

translations.en.sahih: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
translations.en.pickthall: Have We not made the earth an expanse,
translations.en.yusufali: Have We not made the earth as a wide expanse,
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah Kami telah menjadikan bumi itu sebagai hamparan?,

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains as stakes?
translations.en.pickthall: And the high hills bulwarks?
translations.en.yusufali: And the mountains as pegs?
translations.id.indonesian: dan gunung-gunung sebagai pasak?,

translations.en.sahih: And We created you in pairs
translations.en.pickthall: And We have created you in pairs,
translations.en.yusufali: And (have We not) created you in pairs,
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami jadikan kamu berpasang-pasangan,

translations.en.sahih: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
translations.en.pickthall: And have appointed your sleep for repose,
translations.en.yusufali: And made your sleep for rest,
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami jadikan tidurmu untuk istirahat,

translations.en.sahih: And made the night as clothing
translations.en.pickthall: And have appointed the night as a cloak,
translations.en.yusufali: And made the night as a covering,
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami jadikan malam sebagai pakaian,

translations.en.sahih: And made the day for livelihood
translations.en.pickthall: And have appointed the day for livelihood.
translations.en.yusufali: And made the day as a means of subsistence?
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami jadikan siang untuk mencari penghidupan,

transliteration: Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada

translations.en.sahih: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
translations.en.pickthall: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
translations.en.yusufali: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments,
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami bina di atas kamu tujuh buah (langit) yang kokoh,

translations.en.sahih: And made [therein] a burning lamp
translations.en.pickthall: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
translations.en.yusufali: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour?
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami jadikan pelita yang amat terang (matahari),

transliteration: Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja

translations.en.sahih: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
translations.en.pickthall: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,
translations.en.yusufali: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance,
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami turunkan dari awan air yang banyak tercurah,

transliteration: Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata

translations.en.sahih: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
translations.en.pickthall: Thereby to produce grain and plant,
translations.en.yusufali: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables,
translations.id.indonesian: supaya Kami tumbuhkan dengan air itu biji-bijian dan tumbuh-tumbuhan,

translations.en.sahih: And gardens of entwined growth.
translations.en.pickthall: And gardens of thick foliage.
translations.en.yusufali: And gardens of luxurious growth?
translations.id.indonesian: dan kebun-kebun yang lebat?

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
translations.en.yusufali: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Hari Keputusan adalah suatu waktu yang ditetapkan,

arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
transliteration: Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja

translations.en.sahih: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
translations.en.pickthall: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
translations.en.yusufali: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds;
translations.id.indonesian: yaitu hari (yang pada waktu itu) ditiup sangkakala lalu kamu datang berkelompok-kelompok,

transliteration: Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba

translations.en.sahih: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
translations.en.pickthall: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
translations.en.yusufali: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,
translations.id.indonesian: dan dibukalah langit, maka terdapatlah beberapa pintu,

transliteration: Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
translations.en.pickthall: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.
translations.en.yusufali: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage.
translations.id.indonesian: dan dijalankanlah gunung-gunung maka menjadi fatamorganalah ia.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,
translations.en.yusufali: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya neraka Jahannam itu (padanya) ada tempat pengintai,

translations.en.sahih: For the transgressors, a place of return,
translations.en.pickthall: A home for the rebellious.
translations.en.yusufali: For the transgressors a place of destination:
translations.id.indonesian: lagi menjadi tempat kembali bagi orang-orang yang melampaui batas,

translations.en.sahih: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
translations.en.pickthall: They will abide therein for ages.
translations.en.yusufali: They will dwell therein for ages.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka tinggal di dalamnya berabad-abad lamanya,

arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
transliteration: Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba

translations.en.sahih: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
translations.en.pickthall: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
translations.en.yusufali: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink,
translations.id.indonesian: mereka tidak merasakan kesejukan di dalamnya dan tidak (pula mendapat) minuman,

translations.en.sahih: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
translations.en.pickthall: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:
translations.en.yusufali: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,
translations.id.indonesian: selain air yang mendidih dan nanah,

translations.en.sahih: An appropriate recompense.
translations.en.pickthall: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).
translations.en.yusufali: A fitting recompense (for them).
translations.id.indonesian: sebagai pambalasan yang setimpal.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
translations.en.pickthall: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
translations.en.yusufali: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya mereka tidak berharap (takut) kepada hisab,

transliteration: Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba

translations.en.sahih: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
translations.en.pickthall: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.
translations.en.yusufali: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.
translations.id.indonesian: dan mereka mendustakan ayat-ayat Kami dengan sesungguh-sungguhnya.

transliteration: Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba

translations.en.sahih: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
translations.en.pickthall: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
translations.en.yusufali: And all things have We preserved on record.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan segala sesuatu telah Kami catat dalam suatu kitab.

transliteration: Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba

translations.en.sahih: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
translations.en.pickthall: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
translations.en.yusufali: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."
translations.id.indonesian: Karena itu rasakanlah. Dan Kami sekali-kali tidak akan menambah kepada kamu selain daripada azab.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -
translations.en.yusufali: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires;
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa mendapat kemenangan,

translations.en.sahih: Gardens and grapevines
translations.en.pickthall: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,
translations.en.yusufali: Gardens enclosed, and grapevines;
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) kebun-kebun dan buah anggur,

translations.en.sahih: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
translations.en.pickthall: And voluptuous women of equal age;
translations.en.yusufali: And voluptuous women of equal age;
translations.id.indonesian: dan gadis-gadis remaja yang sebaya,

translations.en.sahih: And a full cup.
translations.en.pickthall: And a full cup.
translations.en.yusufali: And a cup full (to the brim).
translations.id.indonesian: dan gelas-gelas yang penuh (berisi minuman).

arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
transliteration: Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba

translations.en.sahih: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
translations.en.pickthall: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
translations.en.yusufali: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalamnya mereka tidak mendengar perkataan yang sia-sia dan tidak (pula) perkataan dusta.

translations.en.sahih: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
translations.en.pickthall: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
translations.en.yusufali: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,
translations.id.indonesian: Sebagai pembalasan dari Tuhanmu dan pemberian yang cukup banyak,

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
transliteration: Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba

translations.en.sahih: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
translations.en.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
translations.en.yusufali: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.
translations.id.indonesian: Tuhan Yang memelihara langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya; Yang Maha Pemurah. Mereka tidak dapat berbicara dengan Dia.

arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
transliteration: Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba

translations.en.sahih: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
translations.en.yusufali: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari, ketika ruh dan para malaikat berdiri bershaf-shaf, mereka tidak berkata-kata, kecuali siapa yang telah diberi izin kepadanya oleh Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah; dan ia mengucapkan kata yang benar.

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
transliteration: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba

translations.en.sahih: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
translations.en.pickthall: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!
translations.id.indonesian: Itulah hari yang pasti terjadi. Maka barangsiapa yang menghendaki, niscaya ia menempuh jalan kembali kepada Tuhannya.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
transliteration: In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (metre) dust!"
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah memperingatkan kepadamu (hai orang kafir) siksa yang dekat, pada hari manusia melihat apa yang telah diperbuat oleh kedua tangannya; dan orang kafir berkata: "Alangkah baiknya sekiranya aku dahulu adalah tanah".
